nights.title: THE SHEEPDOGS - Out All Night Tour
nights.name: The Sheepdogs
nights.extract: The Sheepdogs are a Canadian rock band formed in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan, in 2004. The Sheepdogs were the first unsigned band to make the cover of Rolling Stone and have gone on to a career featuring multi-platinum album sales and four Juno Awards.
